description: This file defines the 'Config' class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages configuration data, including setting and retrieving configuration values, managing path namespaces, and loading configuration files dynamically.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that handles configuration settings, paths, and loading configuration files, facilitating modular configuration management within OpenCart.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a path or namespace mapping to the configuration, either setting the main directory or a subpath.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for a given key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a PHP configuration file, merges its contents into the current data, and returns the configuration array.
